phase.title: Lite Combined Phases 2-5 - Economic Review and Seal

required: Complete Phase-3 threat and domain registries
Complete Phase-4 manual/specialist coverage and candidates
conditional: Rebound evidence after a material identity change

steps.instruction: Consume the sealed Phase-4 coverage/candidate registry and accepted Source Intelligence, then reopen only economic/math-relevant source anchors needed to review value flows, incentives, extraction, conservation, insolvency, allocation, units, bounds, ratios, precision, rounding, time/rate behavior and numerical edge cases. Do not restart broad manual review.

steps.action: Perform bounded contradiction and candidate reconciliation
steps.instruction: Compare Phase-5 conclusions against sealed properties, hypotheses and Phase-4 candidates; reopen only contradiction-specific anchors and record CONFIRMED, CONTRADICTED, NEW or UNRESOLVED. Do not repeat a clean-room or whole-source retrace.

steps.action: Seal one combined milestone and hand off
steps.instruction: Reconcile and seal the combined report and global control checkpoints once; create P5_TO_P6 for reviewer-3L and enter WAITING_FOR_SUCCESSOR_AGENT.

sealingCriteria: Every contract has complete manual coverage
Every activated material domain has evidence or a typed blocker
Every material candidate has a Lite validation obligation or disposition
Combined artifacts and P5_TO_P6 handoff are sealed

recoveryRoutes.route: Repair only the incomplete segment or record
Invalidate or rebind and rerun only impacted work
